title: Dinner for Six

pre.en: What did Chen forget to do?

intro: 一篇日记体的小故事：Chen 第一次在家请客，从傍晚六点写到深夜，每段开头都是一个时间。读的时候留意现在完成时：每到一个时间点，他都在说「到这一刻为止」的情况——刚刚做了什么（just），已经做了什么（already），还没做什么（yet）。

sentences.en: 6:00 p.m. OK, five people from work are coming to dinner at seven — my first dinner party ever.
sentences.zh: 晚上六点。好，五个同事七点来家里吃饭——这是我这辈子头一回请客。

sentences.en: I've just got back from the supermarket, and I haven't started cooking yet.
sentences.zh: 我刚从超市回来，饭还没开始做。

sentences.en: Tom's working tonight, so I'm on my own.
sentences.zh: Tom 今晚上班，就我一个人。

sentences.en: I've never cooked for six people before, but how hard can it be?
sentences.zh: 我从没给六个人做过饭，不过能有多难呢？

sentences.en: I'm going to try out a new recipe: lemon chicken with rice.
sentences.zh: 我打算试一道新菜：柠檬鸡配米饭。

sentences.en: 6:40 p.m. I've already burnt the rice.
sentences.zh: 六点四十。米饭已经烧煳了。

sentences.en: Lesson one: never cook in a hurry.
sentences.zh: 教训一：做饭千万别急。

sentences.en: I've also made a mess of the kitchen.
sentences.zh: 厨房也被我搞得一团糟。

sentences.en: How is there flour on the ceiling?
sentences.zh: 天花板上怎么会有面粉？

sentences.en: And I haven't set the table yet.
sentences.zh: 桌子还没摆呢。

sentences.en: Don't panic, Chen.
sentences.zh: 别慌，小陈。

sentences.en: 7:00 p.m. The first guests have turned up — on time, of course.
sentences.zh: 七点。头一批客人到了——当然是准时到的。

sentences.en: And the chicken hasn't even gone in the oven yet.
sentences.zh: 可鸡连烤箱都还没进呢。

sentences.en: Raj has just called.
sentences.zh: Raj 刚打来电话。

sentences.en: He's got lost somewhere on the metro.
sentences.zh: 他在地铁里不知道哪儿迷路了。

sentences.en: 7:30 p.m. Good news.
sentences.zh: 七点半。好消息。

sentences.en: Ana from the design team used to be a chef, and she's just taken over my kitchen.
sentences.zh: 设计组的 Ana 以前当过厨师，她刚刚把我的厨房接管了。

sentences.en: "Leave it to me," she said.
sentences.zh: 「交给我吧，」她说。

sentences.en: So now I'm washing the pans.
sentences.zh: 所以我现在在洗锅。

sentences.en: "Help yourselves to bread," I told the others.
sentences.zh: 「大家先吃点面包，别客气，」我招呼其他人。

sentences.en: 9:00 p.m. We haven't stopped laughing all evening.
sentences.zh: 九点。我们笑了一晚上，就没停过。

sentences.en: It took Ana twenty minutes to save dinner.
sentences.zh: Ana 只花了二十分钟就把这顿饭救回来了。

sentences.en: Raj finally found his way here at eight, just in time to eat.
sentences.zh: Raj 八点总算找到了地方，刚好赶上开饭。

sentences.en: Everyone says they can't wait to come back.
sentences.zh: 大家都说巴不得下次再来。

sentences.en: 11:30 p.m. Everyone's gone home.
sentences.zh: 晚上十一点半。客人都走了。

sentences.en: I've just opened the fridge and found the dessert.
sentences.zh: 我刚打开冰箱，发现了甜点。

sentences.en: I forgot to serve it.
sentences.zh: 忘了端出来了。

sentences.en: Oh well.
sentences.zh: 算了。

sentences.en: Breakfast is sorted.
sentences.zh: 明天的早饭有着落了。

cards.note: to use or visit something new to see if you like it
读 /ˈresəpi/，三个音节，末尾的 e 要读出来。
doing something quickly because you do not have much time
cards.tip: 放在动作后面说「匆忙地做」：cook in a hurry；be in a hurry 是「赶时间」。
cards.example: Never send an important email in a hurry.

cards.note: to make a place dirty or untidy, or to do something very badly
cards.tip: make a mess of + 地方或事情：make a mess of the kitchen，make a mess of the presentation（把演讲搞砸）。收拾残局是 clean up the mess。
cards.example: The builders made a mess of the new office.

cards.note: 和 flower（花）读音相同，都读 /ˈflaʊə/；面粉不可数。
to put plates, knives, forks and glasses on a table before a meal
cards.tip: 英式也说 lay the table；饭后收拾餐桌是 clear the table。set 的过去式、过去分词都是 set。
cards.example: Could you set the table while I finish the salad?

cards.note: to arrive, often late or when people are not sure you will come
cards.tip: 第 3 课是锁匠「终于露面」，这里是客人「来了」；正式一点用 arrive。
cards.example: Half the team turned up late for the stand-up.

cards.note: at the right time, not late
cards.tip: on time 是按时、不晚；in time 是「及时、来得及」：just in time to eat 正好赶上开饭。
cards.example: For once, the release went out on time.

cards.note: 读 /ˈʌvn/，o 读 /ʌ/；put sth in the oven 放进烤箱，微波炉是 microwave。
to become unable to find your way
to take control of something from someone else
cards.tip: take over sth / take sth over 都行；过去式 took over，过去分词 taken over。名词 takeover 是「接管、收购」。
cards.example: Priya will take over the project while I'm on holiday.

cards.note: frying pan 煎锅；pots and pans 泛指锅碗瓢盆。
to take food or drink without waiting for someone to serve you
cards.tip: 对一群人说 help yourselves；要说拿什么，后面用 to：help yourself to some cake。
cards.example: There's coffee in the kitchen — help yourself.

cards.text: It takes sb + 时间 + to do
cards.note: used to say how much time someone needs to do something
cards.tip: 想强调「只花了」就加 only：It only took her twenty minutes；问「要多久」说 How long does it take to …?
cards.example: It takes about ten minutes to run all the tests.

cards.note: to reach a place by finding the right way to go
to be very excited about something and want it to happen soon
cards.tip: 后面接动词原形：can't wait to see you；也可以接名词：I can't wait for the weekend。
cards.example: I can't wait to see the new office.

cards.note: 重音在后：/dɪˈzɜːt/；别和 desert（沙漠，重音在前）弄混。英式口语也叫 pudding。
serve dinner 开饭、上菜；餐馆里服务员也用这个词：Are you being served?（有人招呼您吗？）
